vault_lines: I ain't have to go to McDonald's, I'm ridin' with a ten-piece chicken
meaning:
This could go one of several ways, depending on your perception of how D is using the word “chicken” on this line~

1) Literally, he didn’t need to go to Mickey D’s because he already has a 10-piece chicken meal to eat (but not likely what he meant in this situation).

2) He’s using “chicken” as a term for money; he’s riding around with $10,000 on his person.

3) Some people use the word “chicken” to refer to marijuana (or other drugs, but mostly weed), so perhaps D is saying that he’s riding around with 10 pounds of cannabis. 10-piece chicken nuggets, weed is a bunch of nugs…see what I mean?

Any way you choose to interpret this line, I think it’s one of the best examples of Bossman Dlow’s unique flavor of expression, his voice, and his personal style. It also sets the tone for the upcoming line, the one the song is named after, the one where D talks about his singular objective and how anyone who disagrees must be on some shit.
